chat.label: Test conversation
chat.emptyDescription: Messages you send here run the selected version. Customers never see them.

composer.label: Message as the test user
composer.waitingHint: Waiting for a person. Write as the customer to test what they see, or switch to Operator to take over.
composer.handledHint: A person handles this chat. Customer messages don’t start a turn until it is handed back.

ended.hint: The agent closed this chat. Start a new conversation to keep testing.
ended.inactiveHint: Closed after inactivity. In live chats the customer's next message starts a new conversation.

operator.hint: Simulates taking over and handing back. Nobody is notified.

trace.label: Flow trace
trace.title: Live flow · turn {{number}}
trace.noFlow: This version's flow can't be shown

details.label: Turn details
details.empty: Send a message to see what ran
details.title: Turn {{number}}

defaultPath.end: Default exit · message sent, chat closed

exit.connectedMessage: The agent sends nothing here; {{name}} and the steps after it decide what the customer sees.

note.live: Draft runs here only — customers keep talking to v{{number}} until you publish.
note.noLive: Draft runs here only — customers don't see it until you publish.

noAgents.title: Nothing to simulate yet
noAgents.description: Create an agent first, then test it here before customers see it.

brokenDraft.title: Fix the flow first
brokenDraft.description: The draft is empty or has errors, so it can't run. Fix it in the flow builder or pick a published version.
brokenDraft.issueDescription: {{issue}}. The simulator can’t run {{draft}} until every step is valid. Or pick a published version.

versions.label: Versions
versions.footnote: Published versions can't be edited. Restoring an old version copies it into a new draft; nothing changes for customers until you publish.

never.title: Not published yet
never.description: Publish the draft to make it live. Every published version stays here, and you can restore it later.

compare.title: What changed in v{{number}}
compare.subtitle: compared with v{{number}}
compare.first: v{{number}} is the first version, so there's nothing to compare it with.

restore.title: Restore v{{number}} as the draft?
restore.subtitle: {{name}} · published {{date}}
restore.intro: We copy v{{number}} into a new draft. Nothing changes for customers until you publish.
restore.introLive: We copy v{{number}} into a new draft. Customers stay on v{{live}} until you publish.
restore.warning_one: Your current draft v{{draft}} has {{count}} unpublished change. It'll be replaced.
restore.warning_other: Your current draft v{{draft}} has {{count}} unpublished changes. They'll be replaced.

next.autoClose: Next: auto-close after {{after}} of silence (Flow settings)
next.trigger: Next: inactivity follow-up {{attempt}} after {{after}} of silence

refused.escalated: The trigger skips chats that were escalated.
refused.channel_excluded: The trigger is off for this channel type.
refused.over_limit: The workspace is over its usage limit, so no follow-up runs.
refused.agent_unavailable: The agent is paused or deleted, so no follow-up runs.
refused.undeliverable: The last message could not be delivered, so no follow-up runs.
refused.stale: The silence was interrupted. Send a message and try again.

schedule.description: Runs the schedule now for this test conversation only. Its conditions are shown as checks; the run goes ahead even when one is not met.

check.customer_wrote: The customer wrote at least once

schedule.notActive: The agent is not answering this chat right now.
schedule.needsCustomer: Send one message as the customer first.
schedule.switchHint: Switch to Message to write as the customer.
